searchText: Apparently we don't have it yet. The idea is to use `timestamp` instead of `number` with no change to the algorithm as the spec uses `uint64` for fork identifier which perfectly fits both value types, and `timestamp` is greater than any block `number` IMO, we need an EIP that generalises EIP-2124 saying that *any* number can be used as a fork trigger in `FORK_NEXT` and `FORK_HASH` computations as long as this number fits into `uint64`. Where can i read about how block proposals gets selected? Been searching the docs to no avail https://eth2book.info/bellatrix/part2/building_blocks/randomness https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#compute_proposer_index (and find where it's called) Thank you very much!
